footer.description: Rentaj is a modern platform for listing, booking, and managing rentals of every kind — from real estate and event spaces to vehicles, machinery, and equipment. No commission, no middlemen.

cookies.message: Rentaj uses cookies to make the platform work and to understand how you use it.

cookiesPage.subtitle: Which cookies we use and how you can change your choice.
cookiesPage.essentialText: Enable core platform functions — login, sessions, and security. These can't be turned off, since Rentaj wouldn't work without them.
cookiesPage.analyticsText: Help us understand how the platform is used so we can improve it. Only enabled with your consent.
cookiesPage.noChoiceYet: You haven't chosen your cookie preference yet.

listing.categoryPickSubtitle: Pick your listing's category — one click takes you straight to the first step. The category decides which fields you fill in next, from amenities to how bookings work.
listing.unlockYourCategoryHint: Don't see your category? Send us a suggestion.
listing.chooseSubcategory: Choose the subcategory that best describes your listing.
listing.proposeCategoryExplain: Don't see a category that describes what you're renting out? Describe it briefly — we'll open it, and your listing is kept as a draft until the category is ready.
listing.proposeByStayHint: the guest picks arrival and departure dates
listing.proposeBySlotHint: the guest picks a time slot within the day
listing.proposePriceUnitHint: day · night · month · hour — we'll choose it together with you when we open the category.
listing.proposeDescriptionPlaceholder: What are you renting out, to whom, and how is it usually booked?
listing.proposeCategoryNote: We'll email you once the category is open. Until then your listing stays in “My listings” as a draft and doesn't use up a package.
listing.proposeCategorySubmittedMessage: Your proposal has been submitted. We'll contact you once we assign the right category to your listing.
listing.stepBasicsDesc: The title and description are the first thing guests see about your listing. Make them clear and appealing.
listing.stepAttributesDesc: Fill in the details specific to your listing's category. Search filters are built from these fields too.

stepAttributesDescCategory.playroom: Fill in the details specific to playrooms. Search filters are built from these fields too.
stepAttributesDescCategory.apartment: Guests see these fields in the "Details" and "Amenities" sections, and the first five in the strip under the photos too.
stepAttributesDescCategory.house: Houses have the most highlighted details: five values go into the strip under the photos.
stepAttributesDescCategory.room: For rooms, the strip under the photos shows capacity, beds, bathroom and area.
stepAttributesDescCategory.eventSpace: For event spaces, capacity, space type and catering go into the strip under the photos.
stepAttributesDescCategory.car: For vehicles, seats, transmission, fuel and year go into the strip under the photos. The rest stays in "Details".
stepAttributesDescCategory.van: For delivery vehicles, payload, cargo volume, transmission and year go into the strip.
stepAttributesDescCategory.machine: An excavator has two separate groups to check: Attachments and Equipment. Machine type, power, weight and year go into the strip.
stepAttributesDescCategory.warehouse: For warehouses, area, space height and space type go into the strip under the photos.

detailsHint.bathroom: Private or shared: guests ask this first.

listing.detailsPreviewEmpty: The fields you fill in show here the way guests see them on the listing.
listing.detailsFiltersCaption: The same fields become filters when searching {category}:
listing.detailsFiltersCaptionDefault: The same fields become search filters:

playroom.tip1: Check only what you really have: guests filter by these items and expect them on site.
playroom.tip2: The filter looks for listings that have every chosen item, so each unchecked item means fewer views.
playroom.tip3: Match the children capacity to the maximum number of guests in the "{step}" step.
playroom.tip4: The children's age range shows parents right away whether the place suits their child.
playroom.tip5: These fields also show in the "Details" section of the listing, not only in search.

apartment.tip1: Capacity, rooms, beds, floor and area go into the strip under the photos; enter them accurately.
apartment.tip2: The number of beds matters more to guests than the number of rooms.
apartment.tip3: Amenities are a search filter; check only what you really have.
apartment.tip4: Floor and lift together answer the question guests ask most.
apartment.tip5: Enter the area without the terrace and shared spaces.

house.tip1: All five values show in the strip under the photos.
house.tip2: A pool, a barbecue and a terrace are the most wanted amenities for cottages.
house.tip3: If the house has several levels, say so in the description, not in the number of rooms.
house.tip4: Pets are a common filter; don't skip it.
house.tip5: The area means the indoor space.

room.tip1: The bathroom (private / shared) is the most important detail for rooms.
room.tip2: Count a double bed as one bed, not two.
room.tip3: "Private entrance" clearly sets a listing apart in search.
room.tip4: A room's area doesn't include shared spaces.
room.tip5: If the room is part of a house, say so in the description.

eventSpace.tip1: Give the capacity for a seated layout; the cocktail capacity goes into the description.
eventSpace.tip2: Catering is the most common cause of misunderstandings; be precise.
eventSpace.tip3: A sound system and a microphone set a hall apart for bigger parties.
eventSpace.tip4: If music is limited after a certain hour, write it in the description.
eventSpace.tip5: Parking and air conditioning are often asked for at bigger parties.

car.tip1: Seats, transmission, fuel and year go into the strip under the photos.
car.tip2: Transmission and fuel are the most common vehicle filters.
car.tip3: The make shows in "Details"; write the model in the listing title.
car.tip4: Navigation and a roof rack often decide the choice.
car.tip5: If the vehicle has a mileage limit, write it in the description.

van.tip1: Payload and volume are the first two things guests look at.
van.tip2: The cargo space dimensions prevent the most misunderstandings.
van.tip3: If you also offer a driver, explain in the description how that is charged.
van.tip4: If a C licence is needed, be sure to say so.
van.tip5: For moves, guests first look at the cargo space length and height.

machine.tip1: Machine type, power, weight and year go into the strip under the photos.
machine.tip2: "With operator" is a filter in machine search, not just information.
machine.tip3: For excavators, attachments and equipment are two separate lists, not one.
machine.tip4: Machine delivery is almost always charged separately; explain how.
machine.tip5: The machine's weight decides whether it can reach the site at all.

warehouse.tip1: Area, height and space type go into the strip under the photos.
warehouse.tip2: Clear height matters more to guests than area for palletised goods.
warehouse.tip3: A loading ramp and truck access most often decide the choice.
warehouse.tip4: If part of the warehouse is rented out, say so clearly in the description.
warehouse.tip5: Warehouses are usually priced per month.

default.tip1: Check only what you really have: guests filter by these items and expect them on site.
default.tip2: The filter looks for listings that have every chosen item, so each unchecked item means fewer views.
default.tip3: These fields also show in the "Details" section of the listing, not only in search.

listing.stepLocationDesc: An accurate location makes it easier for guests to find and book your place.
listing.stepPhotosDesc: The first photo (marked as Cover) is the one guests see first in search. Drag photos to reorder them.
listing.stepPricingDesc: Choose whether you accept online bookings and set your price.
listing.stepPricingDescSlot: Choose whether you accept online bookings, how time slots are created and what an hour costs.
listing.pricingPreviewTitle: How it looks on the listing
listing.pricingPreviewCaption: The preview changes with the booking method you choose.
listing.pricingTipOnline: "Online booking" gives the listing a calendar and a request button; without it the guest only sees your contact details.
listing.pricingTipSlotSubmode: Working hours are easier to keep up to date, while defined time slots suit fixed shifts better.
listing.pricingTipNoCommission: You enter the price per {unit}, with no commission; Rentaj charges neither you nor the guest.
listing.pricingTipWeekendNight: The weekend price applies to Friday and Saturday nights, except for dates with their own price in the calendar.
listing.pricingTipWeekendDay: The weekend price applies on Fridays and Saturdays, except for dates with their own price in the calendar.
listing.pricingTipWeekendSlot: The weekend price applies on Fridays and Saturdays, except for time slots with their own price in the next step.
listing.pricingTipChangeLater: You can change the booking method later by editing the listing.
listing.validationLocationRequired: Select a region, a city, and enter an address before continuing.
listing.validationPhotosRequired: Add at least one photo before continuing.
listing.validationPriceRequired: Enter a price greater than 0 before continuing.
listing.validationSlotsRequired: Add at least one time slot before continuing.
listing.stepAvailabilityDesc: Set up the calendar or schedule for your listing.
listing.stepAvailabilityDescWorkingHours: Set your available days and working hours. Guests pick a time slot from them, and exceptions override the regular schedule.
listing.stepAvailabilityDescDefinedSlots: You set the exact time slots a guest can book.
listing.stepRulesDesc: Duration, guest count, and how far ahead/late a guest can book.
listing.stepRulesDescSlot: Duration, guest count, and how far ahead or how late a guest can request a time slot.
listing.stepPaymentDesc: Payment method, advance, request handling, and cancellation terms.
listing.stepReviewDesc: Check that everything is ready before you submit the listing for approval. An administrator reviews it within 24 hours and you'll get an email notification.
listing.monthlyPricingNotice: The listing books in whole calendar months. The guest picks a starting month and how many months to book.
listing.definedSlotsPriceNotice: Each time slot has its own price, set in the next step: "{step}".
listing.maxAdvanceBookingDays: Furthest ahead a booking is accepted
listing.maxAdvanceBookingDaysHint: A guest can't request a date further than this many days from today.
listing.maxAdvanceBookingDaysHintStay: A guest can't request a date further than this many days from today.
listing.noAttributesForCategory: This category has no additional fields yet.
listing.whHourlyRangesHint: If you don't add a range, the base price {unit} from the previous step applies.
listing.whMidnightCrossHint: The working hours run into the next day (for example 20:00-02:00).
listing.whPerDayCaptionOff: The same working hours currently apply to every selected day.
listing.whPerDayCaptionOn: Each selected day has its own working hours and time-of-day prices.
listing.whHourlyRangesHintWeekend: If you don't add a range, the base price {unit} from the previous step applies, and the weekend price on Fridays and Saturdays.
listing.whSpecialPriceIncomplete: Choose a date and enter the special price.
listing.availabilityPreviewTitle: How a guest picks a time slot
listing.availabilityPreviewNoSlots: The time slots you add will show here.
listing.availabilityPreviewCaptionWh: A special price for the date comes first, then the time-of-day price, then the weekend price, and last the base price.
listing.availabilityPreviewCaptionWhNoWeekend: A special price for the date comes first, then the time-of-day price, and last the base price.
listing.availabilityPreviewCaptionDs: Guests pick a ready time slot from the list and don't enter a time themselves.
listing.whTipDayOff: Switch a day off instead of editing the listing when you don't work; guests then don't see it in the calendar.
listing.whTipRanges: Price ranges are optional; without them the base price {unit} from the previous step applies.
listing.whTipRangesWeekend: Price ranges are optional; without them the base price {unit} applies, and the weekend price on Fridays and Saturdays.
listing.whTipSpecialPrice: A special price for a specific date beats the weekend price too.
listing.whTipSpecialPriceNoWeekend: A special price for a specific date beats the price ranges too.
listing.whTipBlocked: A blocked date removes every time slot that day, including those in price ranges.
listing.whTipDuration: You set the minimum and maximum length of a booking in the next step.
listing.dsAddIncomplete: Choose a date and enter the price of the time slot.
listing.dsNote: Guests pick only from this list; there's no free choice of time. Every time slot has its own price, so weekend and special prices don't apply here.
listing.dsTipCopy: You can copy a time slot to several dates at once, by hand or every week.
listing.dsTipBooked: A time slot a guest has booked is no longer offered to other guests.
listing.dsTipBlocked: A blocked date removes every time slot that day, including ones already set.
listing.dsTipRemove: Delete a time slot you no longer offer; guests then won't see it on the listing.
listing.dsTipDuration: You set the length per time slot, so the next step has no minimum or maximum length.
listing.dropzoneHint: or click to choose from your device · JPG, PNG up to 10MB
listing.photoCountRecommendation: We recommend at least 5 photos — listings with more photos get more inquiries.
listing.setCoverPhotoHint: Click the star to set another photo as the cover
listing.pricingBookingOnlineSlotDesc: The guest picks a time slot and sends a request through Rentaj. The listing gets a calendar of free time slots.
listing.pricingBookingOnlineStayDesc: The guest picks dates and sends a request through Rentaj. The listing gets a calendar of free dates.
listing.pricingBookingNoneDesc: The listing has no calendar and no requests. The guest sees your contact details and arranges everything with you directly.
listing.slotSubmodeWorkingHoursDesc: You enter your working hours and available days, and the guest picks a time slot within them.
listing.slotSubmodeDefinedDesc: You set the exact time slots yourself (for example 10:00-12:00 and 12:30-14:30). The guest picks only from that list.
listing.slotSubmodeNextStepNote: This choice changes the next step: "{step}".
listing.title: Listing title
listing.titleHint: Short and specific. The title appears on the listing card in search results.
listing.descriptionHint: Explain what guests get. The start of the description is visible before a guest opens the full text.
listing.videoUrlHint: The listing shows a Watch video button, and the video opens over the whole page.
listing.basicsTipLocation: Put the neighborhood in the title; guests search by location.

basicsTipFirstParagraph.playroom: Mention the children's age range and the capacity in the first paragraph.
basicsTipFirstParagraph.apartment: Mention the number of rooms and guests in the first paragraph.
basicsTipFirstParagraph.room: Mention the number of beds and guests in the first paragraph.
basicsTipFirstParagraph.eventSpace: Mention the capacity and the type of event in the first paragraph.
basicsTipFirstParagraph.car: Mention the model, year and number of seats in the first paragraph.
basicsTipFirstParagraph.van: Mention the payload and the size of the cargo space in the first paragraph.
basicsTipFirstParagraph.machine: Mention the machine type, its weight and whether an operator comes with it in the first paragraph.
basicsTipFirstParagraph.warehouse: Mention the floor area, ceiling height and truck access in the first paragraph.
basicsTipFirstParagraph.default: Put the most important details in the first paragraph.

listing.basicsTipCaps: Skip capital letters and exclamation marks; the title gets cut off on the card.
listing.basicsTipPhone: Don't put a phone number in the description; contact details unlock through a booking.
listing.basicsTipVideo: The video doesn't need to be professional; a walkthrough filmed on a phone does the job.
listing.mapPinHint: The pin is placed automatically from the address. Click the map or drag the pin to mark the exact spot.
listing.googlePlaceIdHint: Enter your Google Place ID so your Google reviews show up on the listing.
listing.priceUnitFixedHint: For {category}, the price unit is the {unit}.
listing.priceCardHint: On the card and in search it shows as "{price}".
listing.weekendPriceHintNight: Applies automatically to Friday and Saturday nights, except for dates with a custom price in the calendar in the next step.
listing.weekendPriceHintDay: Applies automatically on Fridays and Saturdays, except for dates with a custom price in the calendar in the next step.
listing.weekendPriceHintSlot: Applies automatically on Fridays and Saturdays, except for time slots with their own price in the next step.
listing.weekendPriceSuggestion: The base price is suggested until you change it.
listing.paymentMethodDescCASH: The guest pays you directly, outside the platform. Rentaj does not issue a payment QR code.
listing.paymentMethodDescBANK_TRANSFER: The guest gets an IPS QR code with the amount and the details for paying into your account.
listing.paymentMethodDescBOTH: The guest chooses to pay in cash or via the IPS QR code.
listing.requestHandlingInstant: Send the QR code immediately, no approval
listing.requestHandlingApprovalDesc: The request stays pending until you approve it manually.
listing.requestHandlingInstantDesc: The guest gets the QR code right away, and the booking is confirmed once the payment arrives.
listing.requestHandlingCashNotice: Unavailable for cash payment: with no QR code there's no automatic confirmation, so every request must be approved manually.
listing.cancellationFreeUntilDays: Free cancellation up to {threshold} day(s) before
listing.cancellationFreeUntilHours: Free cancellation up to {threshold} hour(s) before
listing.noPaymentThroughPlatformNotice: Note: Rentaj never receives or forwards the guest's money. Payment and any refund are strictly an agreement between you and the guest.
listing.advancePercentHint: The part of the amount the guest pays in advance for the booking to be confirmed.
listing.paymentDeadlineHoursHint: If the payment doesn't arrive within this time, the slot is released.
listing.paymentBankAccountMissing: Guests can only get the QR code once you add your bank account.
listing.cancellationNoneDesc: A confirmed booking can't be cancelled for free.
listing.cancellationOptionDays: Free cancellation up to days before the start
listing.cancellationOptionHours: Free cancellation up to hours before the start
listing.paymentFlowTitle: How a booking goes with this choice

paymentFlow.requestDesc: The slot is held for now.
paymentFlow.requestDescChoice: They pick cash or the QR code, and the slot is held for now.
paymentFlow.approveDesc: The request waits until you answer.
paymentFlow.cashConfirmedTitle: The booking is confirmed right away
paymentFlow.cashConfirmedDesc: The guest pays you in cash, outside the platform.
paymentFlow.qrTitle: The guest gets the QR code
paymentFlow.qrInstantTitle: The guest gets the QR code right away
paymentFlow.confirmationOrQrTitle: The guest gets a confirmation or the QR code
paymentFlow.qrDescAdvance: It comes with the advance amount and the payment details.
paymentFlow.qrDescFull: It comes with the amount and the payment details.
paymentFlow.qrInstantDescBoth: If they pick cash, you still approve the request.
paymentFlow.paymentDesc: Only then is the booking confirmed.
paymentFlow.paymentDescQr: Only then is a QR booking confirmed.

listing.paymentTipBoth: "Both" is the most flexible: the guest picks cash or QR, and you still approve every request.
listing.paymentTipBothInstant: "Both" is the most flexible: the guest picks cash or QR, and you still approve cash requests.
listing.paymentTipAdvance: An advance protects the slot from last-minute cancellations, but too high an advance puts guests off.
listing.paymentTipDeadline: The payment deadline keeps the slot blocked; a short one frees the date sooner.
listing.paymentTipCancellation: Guests see the cancellation terms on the listing before they send a request.
listing.paymentTipMoney: The money goes straight to you; Rentaj isn't involved in the payment or any refund.
listing.earliestBookingHoursHint: A guest must send a request at least this many hours before the booking starts.
listing.earliestBookingHoursHintStay: A guest must send a request at least this many hours before the booking starts.
listing.rulesDurationNote: The unit follows the "Price unit" from step 2.
listing.rulesDurationNoteSlot: The unit follows the "Price unit" from step 2. With "Defined time slots" chosen, these fields are hidden.
listing.rulesDurationNoteGuestPrice: Length is counted in hours even when the price is per guest. With "Defined time slots" chosen, these fields are hidden.
listing.rulesGuestsHint: The maximum is also checked when booking; a guest can't request a larger number.

rulesGapHint.playroom: Time kept free after each time slot, to get the room ready.
rulesGapHint.eventSpace: Time kept free after each time slot, to get the room ready.
rulesGapHint.stay: Time kept free after each booking, to get the place ready.
rulesGapHint.vehicle: Time kept free after each booking, to get the vehicle ready.
rulesGapHint.machine: Time kept free after each booking, to get the machine ready.
rulesGapHint.default: Time kept free after each booking.

listing.rulesDurationMaxBelowMin: The maximum length can't be shorter than the minimum.
listing.rulesGuestsMaxBelowMin: The maximum number of guests can't be lower than the minimum.
listing.rulesSummaryTitle: What this means for the guest
listing.rulesSummaryCaption: A request outside these rules can't even be sent; the guest sees why right away.
listing.rulesTipNotice: A notice that is too short means last-minute requests; leave yourself time to reply.
listing.rulesTipHorizonSlot: A booking window that is too long ties up time slots that are hard to change later.
listing.rulesTipHorizonStay: A booking window that is too long ties up dates that are hard to change later.

rulesTipCapacity.children: Match the maximum number of children to the capacity in the "{step}" step.
rulesTipCapacity.guests: Match the maximum number of guests to the capacity in the "{step}" step.
rulesTipCapacity.default: Match the maximum number of guests to the real capacity.

listing.rulesTipDefinedSlots: You set each time slot's length in the previous step, so there's no minimum or maximum length here.

rulesTipGap.playroom: Use the gap after a time slot if you need time to tidy up between birthday parties.
rulesTipGap.eventSpace: Use the gap after a time slot if you need time to tidy up between events.
rulesTipGap.stay: Use the gap after a booking if you need time to get ready between guests.
rulesTipGap.vehicle: Use the gap after a booking if you need time to get the vehicle ready.
rulesTipGap.machine: Use the gap after a booking if you need time to get the machine ready.
rulesTipGap.default: Use the gap after a booking if you need time to get ready between bookings.

listing.rulesTipVehicleTimes: The guest sees the pickup and return times on the listing before sending a request.

rulesTipMinDuration.HOUR: A minimum length is the quickest way to avoid one-hour bookings.
rulesTipMinDuration.NIGHT: A minimum length is the quickest way to avoid one-night bookings.
rulesTipMinDuration.DAY: A minimum length is the quickest way to avoid one-day bookings.
rulesTipMinDuration.MONTH: A minimum length is the quickest way to avoid one-month bookings.
rulesTipMinDuration.default: A minimum length is the quickest way to avoid bookings that are too short.

listing.icalLockedHint: iCal export and import unlock once the listing is published (Standard or Pro package).
listing.icalExportHint: Paste this link into Airbnb, Booking.com or another platform so they know when this listing is taken.
listing.icalImportHint: Add a link to a .ics calendar from another platform to avoid double bookings.
listing.notReadyYet: Fill in the required fields before continuing to package selection
listing.noListingsYet: You don't have any listings yet. Create your first one - it takes less than 2 minutes.
listing.draftHint: Draft - not published. Finish it so guests can see it.
listing.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete this listing? This action is permanent.
listing.contactUnavailable: Contact information isn't currently available for this listing.
listing.previewBanner: This is a preview — guests will only see the listing like this once it's published.
listing.previewListing: See how it looks to a guest
listing.draftSavedExplain: Progress saves automatically after every step — you can find and finish the draft anytime under "My listings".
listing.approximateLocationNote: The location shown is approximate. The exact address is revealed once a booking is confirmed.
listing.phoneAfterConfirmation: The phone number is revealed once a booking is confirmed.
listing.cancellationAfterDeadline: After that deadline, cancellation is arranged directly with the owner.
listing.noMoneyThroughPlatform: Rentaj neither collects nor forwards money. Payment and any refund are arranged between you and the owner.

search.noResultsWithFilters: No listings match your filters. Try broadening or removing some of them.
search.notifySent: We'll notify you when a matching listing appears
search.searchAsIMove: Search as I move the map
search.allSelectedNote: shows listings that have all of the selected
search.mapStaysNote: The map stays on screen while you scroll the results.

faq.q1: How do I publish a listing?
faq.a1: Sign up, fill in your listing through a short wizard, and choose a package. Once an admin approves it, your listing becomes visible to guests.
faq.a2: No. Rentaj never takes a cut of your bookings — we only earn from the owner's monthly or yearly subscription. All booking money goes straight to you.
faq.q3: Can I connect my existing calendar?
faq.a3: Yes, iCal sync (import and export) is available, so you avoid double bookings if you already list elsewhere.
faq.a4: Anyone renting out real estate, event spaces, playrooms, vehicles, machinery, or equipment.
faq.q5: What kinds of bookings can I use?
faq.a5: Direct bookings, per-stay or per-slot bookings, with or without a built-in booking system — whatever fits your needs.
faq.q6: Can guests message me before booking?
faq.a6: Yes, the built-in messaging system lets guests reach you directly on the platform, before and after booking.
